summary: This video breaks down the Season 9 Continental Challenge event in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. The creator showcases the 450-point hero reward, Amalfriede, detailing her Poison support kit, debuffs, shields, and inspiration bonuses. He then reviews the mechanics, strengths, and weaknesses of the six challenge bosses: Rose (Los), Quaesitia (Quechaitia), Stegamoffyn (Stegamerfen), Belder (Beldelle), Sinnaril (Synarell), and Gina Viv (Guinavivre), highlighting team composition rules such as mono-element positioning and multi-element synergy requirement.

heroes.name: Amalfriede
heroes.note: Inflicts multiple debuffs including Attack Penalty II, Accuracy Penalty II, Buff Prohibition, Healing Prohibition, and Silence, while generating self shields and boosting her own ultimate damage.

heroes.name: Rhyviel
heroes.verdict: Top Corrosion DPS pick for Rose boss
heroes.note: Provides massive damage potential for Corrosion compositions against the Rose boss in Continental Challenge.

teams.note: Corrosion team performs exceptionally well; position heroes without friendly adjacent units to gain a 30% damage increase.
Build a mono-element team from the same faction to get a 10% damage bonus while exploiting the boss's +20% critical hit vulnerability.
Deploy a lineup with 3 different elements to unlock a 50% overall damage increase.

meta_changes: Season 9 Continental Challenge introduces six distinct bosses with specific faction, elemental, and positioning rules.
Amalfriede added as the milestone hero reward at 450 points in the Season 9 Continental Challenge.
tips: Each hero on your roster can only be deployed once per week across all Continental Challenge bosses, so plan your compositions carefully.
Match team compositions to boss-specific rules, such as using mono-element teams for Belder or 3 distinct elements for Sinnaril.
Avoid using Wild, Toxin, Thunderbolt, or Shadow against Belder due to his 40% mastery damage reduction; rely on high crit damage instead.
